messages:
violet_csm: Quick flag 101 024 - AsterWave renewal needs invoice to 'AsterWave EU Services' and procurement will sign via a delegated agent. CFO out Tue-Wed.
ravi_cs: Do we have the new legal name + EU VAT? Also confirm PO ref so finance can map.
maria_fin: Vendor code: AW-EU-710. VAT: NL445566778. PO: AW-PO-710-88. Billing contact: arianne.accounts@asterwave.eu. Net30.
sam_sales: Customer also asked to shorten to an 11-month term (they want a March go-live). Pricing will be prorated 11mo = $46,120. Any objections?
susan_legal: Delegated signing allowed with delegation letter that explicitly references the procurement contact and authority to bind. We should add a short attestation checkbox on the envelope and a "delegation reference" line in the signature block. Use "execution date" wording.
violet_csm: Got a scanned delegation_letter.pdf from the customer (procurement contact: Tomasz Nowak <tomasz@asterwave.eu>). They said onboarding can start after procurement signs.
docusign_bot: Draft envelope created: envelope_id=env_AW_710. Routing default: procurement_delegate -> maria_fin -> susan_legal. Checkbox placeholder added with label: "I confirm I am authorized under the attached delegation letter". Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_AW_710
ravi_cs: We also need to preserve Dedicated KMS and include the key fingerprint. Customer insisted on storing key id in the amendment.
susan_legal: Add line: "KMS key fingerprint: SHA256:aa:bb:cc:...:ff" in section 6.1. No legal blockers.
maria_fin: Invoice summary for reference:
```
Term: 11 months
Seats: 100
Total (prorated): $46,120
PO: AW-PO-710-88
Billing email: arianne.accounts@asterwave.eu
```

violet_csm: Checklist I pasted for the thread: 1) attach delegation_letter.pdf 2) update amendment with entity + KMS fingerprint + execution date language 3) create envelope with attestation checkbox 4) finance uploads invoice pdf 5) send envelope today COB to keep March kickoff.
sam_sales: Customer confirmed delegation letter includes delegation ref DL-AW-2024-09. They prefer procurement signs first then we start onboarding.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_AW_710 updated with amendment_v2.pdf and delegation_letter.pdf. Status: ready_to_send.
susan_legal: Quick edit suggestion: change phrase "billing effective on signature" to "billing effective on execution date". I'll add that and approve.
violet_csm: @susan_legal please make that change in the envelope. Time is tight.
susan_legal: Done. Approved and left comment in envelope.
violet_csm: @docusign_bot send envelope to tomasz@asterwave.eu please.
docusign_bot: Envelope env_AW_710 sent to procurement_delegate at 2024-03-14T16:12:00Z.
docusign_bot: Signature event: procurement_delegate signed at 2024-03-14T16:35:22Z. Next recipient: maria_fin.
maria_fin: Signed and uploaded invoice PDF with VAT placeholder filled and billing contact arianne.accounts@asterwave.eu.
docusign_bot: Signature event: maria_fin signed at 2024-03-14T16:52:10Z. Next recipient: susan_legal.
susan_legal: Final review, small numbering nit for KMS clause adjusted. Signing now.
docusign_bot: Signature event: susan_legal signed at 2024-03-14T17:03:21Z. Envelope completed. Final PDF: https://docusign.example/env/env_AW_710/final.pdf
sam_sales: Customer confirmed they uploaded proof of VAT registration to their procurement portal. Onboarding can start after procurement signature.
violet_csm: Renewal executed 11-month term accepted. I'll update the renewal tracker and schedule kickoff for 2024-03-25. Thanks all :rocket:
